title: Babylon's Ashes
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The sixth Expanse book. As a breakaway fleet fighting for the Belt turns to ever more brutal methods, the crew and a coalition of old rivals try to hold the solar system together.
readIf: you like long space-war sagas where politics and personal loyalties are in constant conflict.
skipIf: you haven't read the previous books, as it follows directly from their major events.

pairings.reason: A classic novel about soldiers and what a society asks of them, with a very different philosophy.
A reflective look at the politics of an off-world society built around an ideal.
A ruthless, fast-paced saga about class conflict and war across the planets.
